body: Latent test-time scaling improves reasoning by refining hidden states during inference, but existing methods typically apply a single scalar reward to all editable latent tokens. For multimodal large language models, this global update ignores that generated tokens play different roles: some are sensitive to visual evidence, while others correspond to uncertain reasoning decisions. We present Token-Disentangled Latent Test-Time Scaling, an inference-time framework that makes latent refinement token-role-aware. Starting from an initial generated trajectory, we optimize a short hidden-state prefix while routing perception-side visual feedback to image-sensitive tokens and reasoning feedback to high-entropy tokens. Tokens selected by neither route are constrained by an anchor regularizer. Across both perception and reasoning benchmarks on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B, our method lifts macro accuracy over CoT by +2.57 and +1.51 respectively, and outperforms strong output-space test-time scaling baselines under matched decoded-candidate budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/TD-LTTS.
summaryZh: 本文提出了一种名为“令牌解耦潜在测试时扩展”（Token-Disentangled Latent Test-Time Scaling）的推理框架。针对多模态大模型中不同令牌对视觉证据和推理决策敏感度不同的特点，该方法通过对隐藏状态前缀进行差异化优化，将视觉反馈与推理反馈分别路由至对应令牌。在Qwen2.5-VL和InternVL模型上的实验表明，该技术显著提升了宏观推理准确率，优于传统的输出空间扩展基线，为提升多模态推理能力提供了新路径。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该方法通过令牌解耦的测试时扩展技术，有效提升了多模态大模型的推理性能，具有较高的工程应用价值。

glossary.explanationZh: 在推理阶段通过优化隐藏状态来提升模型推理质量的技术。
将不同类型的令牌（如视觉敏感型与推理敏感型）进行区分处理的策略。
模型推理过程中用于引导后续生成的隐藏状态序列前缀。
用于约束未被特定路由选中的令牌，防止其在优化过程中偏离过大的正则化项。
能够处理文本、图像等多种模态输入的大型语言模型。
